QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_60

question.text: At what collateral utilisation level does a clearing member exit "Risk Reduction Mode" and return to the normal risk management mode?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 178 states that the stock broker is moved back to normal risk management mode only when the percentage of utilised collateral is lower than the level specified by the clearing corporation from time to time, currently 85%. The Trap: 90% is the entry threshold into risk-reduction mode, not the exit threshold; values like 75% or 95% are not the source-specified exit level. Note: The two source-backed facts are entry at 90% and exit currently below 85%; both numbers come from page 178.
